extension.description: Repository for installing and updating the Flixtor Kodi addon.
Browse and stream movies and TV shows from Flixtor using your VIP account.
extension.news: v1.26.0 - Refreshed category and genre artwork now loads correctly after an update (previously Kodi could keep showing the old cached images). v1.25.0 - Tidier Continue Watching: one card per show, finished episodes drop off automatically, and the next episode shows as "Up Next" so you can keep going. Refreshed category and genre artwork. v1.24.0 - Much faster browsing (compressed transfers, pages cached across navigations, no redundant warm-up fetches). Continue Watching on the main menu, synopses and real backdrop art on every title, watched checkmarks and progress bars in lists, TV trailers, smarter breadcrumbs. v1.23.0 - Automatic daily cache cleanup, "View cache storage usage" report, and per-cache clear buttons in Settings > Maintenance.
